objective: Test one bounded change: target-free per-user residual-spread attenuation to remove systematic Toys harm while preserving Beauty growth.

single_changed_factor.name: target_free_per_user_residual_spread_budget
single_changed_factor.definition: Multiply every candidate residual for one user by min(1, budget / (max_residual - min_residual)); budget=0 is exact identity.
single_changed_factor.selection_scope: one budget per development domain, shared across all three seeds
single_changed_factor.frozen_components: candidate construction, six features, residual architecture, fit/calibration split, loss, optimizer, steps, seeds, parent checkpoints

residual.loss: identical equal-weight head/tail target-vs-highest-negative hinge loss from GACR-v2

budget_selection.eligible: Recall@10 nondecrease, tail NDCG@10 nondecrease, and broad harm <=1% in every seed calibration cell of the domain
budget_selection.objective: maximum mean relative overall NDCG@10 gain within each development domain
budget_selection.tie_break: lower maximum broad harm, then higher changed-user coverage, then smaller budget

development_reporting: matched P0, unclipped GACR-v2, and GACR-v3
three-seed stability and incremental delta versus v2

decision_rule.continue_to_cet_combination: GACR-v3 improves mean Toys NDCG@10 versus unclipped v2 without mean Recall@10 loss and preserves positive mean Beauty NDCG@10.
decision_rule.continue_gacr_only: A predeclared subgroup or coverage mechanism improves with no catastrophic domain loss and directly supports one further bounded fix.
decision_rule.stop_current_configuration: identity is selected for Toys or Toys remains negative without a direct safety improvement.

post_run_policy: Write results only. Do not analyze, retry, read Sports/test, or start CET until the researcher explicitly requests analysis.
